settings.text: Questions about an order, a product or a gift set? Write to us — we reply within a day.

settings.question: How long does delivery take?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 1–2 business days. Delivery across the country usually takes 2–4 days.

settings.question: Can I return a product?
settings.answer: Yes — unopened products can be returned within 14 days. Write to us and we will arrange a free pickup.

settings.text: The quickest answers to the questions we get most.
